answer: A floatovoltaic attestation scheme ties each agent identity to solar telemetry on an industrial lagoon. At dawn, a verifier prompts the agent to sink a brief current pulse, recording panel voltage drop and internal impedance. An attacker attempting a Sybil attack incurs the verifiable hardware expense of provisioning separate physical solar modules per identity. However, morning fog can attenuate local irradiance, spuriously rejecting legitimate agents.
